notCaptured: no clipboard, copy or hand-off control exists in apps/angular-ai-devtools/src/app or extension/: a tree-wide search for `clipboard` matches four documents and no source file, so the copy side here is the module that composes text for the agent, not a control that copies.

no caller in the tree builds a fact list from a console finding. The fact list handed to the copy path for each subject is that subject's own rendered pane lines — the most favourable input it could be given — so this records what the composer does with the pane's lines, not an existing console hand-off.

the pane text recorded is the whole surface text (`ConsoleSurface.text`) for an answer carrying that one finding, not the finding's block alone. The two answers are the first two findings of the demo's console answer (`apps/angular-ai-devtools/src/app/panel-demo.ts:384-399`), and the pane text was produced by running `consolePanel` on them, not by reading the source.

the copy text was produced by running the two lines that compose it as they are read from the file (the bullet prefix at `extension-prompt.service.ts:85`, the template at `:86`); the module imports `@angular/core`, so the record does not claim the service itself was loaded or that a prompt was sent.

the two differ for both subjects because the composer prefixes each pane line with `- ` and wraps them in its own two sentences. The record claims that difference and no other, and does not compare any other text of either path.
how many findings a real hand-off carries, whether the hand-off is a message or a prompt, and what the agent answers are not measured here.
